# Original DefinitelyTyped archive oracle

Original @types/react19.3.0 npm tarball; source/integrity in manifest.json.
Archive includes its upstream MIT LICENSE. No repacking or source edits.

Node24.16.0, npm11.17.0, bundled pacote21.5.1 extracted these same bytes.
`native-oracle.json`: every resulting regular-file path, size and SHA256.
Tar roots are `react/`; native install yields package.json/index.d.ts at package root.
`path-variants.json`: native results for valid generated archives (each includes
package/package.json), proving strip-one rather than a package-name whitelist.

Regenerate: `node packages/npm-client/src/_test-fixtures/types-react-19.3.0/regenerate-native.mjs`.
Requires the captured npm/pacote versions; installed npm is the reference.
